text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] routing_latency.p99 spike in euw2 detected by probe cluster-router-euw2 (threshold 800ms). Current p95=310ms p99=2.8s. Misroute rate to fallback pool increased to 17% (>5% threshold). Streaming stalls & tail timeouts rising. Pager: maya_oncall.

maya_oncall: I'm oncall, joining bridge now. @rory_router @devon_edgesvc can you ack? Any recent rollouts in euw2? :rotating_light:

rory_router: ack, looking. Saw a partial rollout of routing-policy v3.7.2 at 1777776000 (canary->gradual). Also noticed many keys hashed to hot shard sh-42.

devon_edgesvc: we're seeing spikes on the LB side too — some requests get routed to remote zone (usw1) instead of local euw2. That adds cross-region latency ~1.2s.

maya_oncall: copying logs + quick telemetry. logbot, paste top router-error logs from last 5m

logbot: ```
[1777777765] router: route_apply failed for policy v3.7.2 id=r-20260315-43: computed_weight_sum=1.03 > 1.0
[1777777770] router: fallback_hit zone=usw1 reason=overflow
[1777777772] streaming: stall start conn=abcd1234 addr=10.32.5.8 p99_delay=2500ms
[1777777774] router: hotshard evict attempt count=3 shard=sh-42
```

angela_sre: Rerun quick check: max queue depth on node gpulead-12 is 480 (usual 80). Hot shard sh-42 is owning 23% of traffic. That plus misapplied policy weights would cause both backpressure and cross-zone fallback.

rory_router: I think the rollout math in v3.7.2 has a rounding bug when computing per-zone weights for tiny buckets. It occasionally pushes weight >1 when a hot key list is non-empty. Opened a quick issue: https://tracker/redwood/ISSUE-4821

devon_edgesvc: For immediate mitigation we can: 1) set emergency override to cap weight per-zone to 0.85, 2) rollback r-20260315-43 to v3.7.1, 3) evict hot shard sh-42 to redistribute. Which one first?

maya_oncall: Do the least risky first. Step 1 emergency cap via control-plane override (no restart). Rory, can you push override? I'll prepare rollback if needed.

rory_router: Pushing override now. Command: ```
redwoodctl routing override set --region euw2 --max-zone-weight 0.85 --reason "p99 spike emergency"
```

deploy-bot: action started: override-apply-1777777788 (initiated by rory_router). Progress: 0/3 zones updated.

rory_router: override applied to zonal-configs euw2-aa, euw2-ab, euw2-ac. Verified computed_weight_sum now <= 1.0 on all leaders.

logbot: ```
[1777777796] router: override applied max_zone_weight=0.85
[1777777798] router: computed_weight_sum normalized -> 0.998
[1777777800] streaming: stall count decreased (5m) -> 12 (was 39)
[1777777803] telemetry: p99 reduced -> 1.1s
```

maya_oncall: good first win, p99 down to ~1.1s but still above SLO. Prepare rollback plan. @katy_prod please draft customer impact note (no leak yet but increased latency for streaming customers in euw2).

katy_prod: drafting — will mention potential timeout errors for long-poll streaming and recommend retry/backoff. ETA 6m.

angela_sre: While override helps, hot shard still skewed. Recommend evicting sh-42 gracefully to avoid cache churn. Devon, can you trigger shard-reshuffle with gentle drain?

devon_edgesvc: Scheduling evict now: ```
edgesvc ctl evict-shard --shard sh-42 --mode gradual --target-pct 10 --window 300s
```

deploy-bot: eviction job evict-shard-sh42-1777777818 queued.

logbot: ```
[1777777825] evict-shard: started shard=sh-42 mode=gradual target_pct=10 window=300s
[1777777835] router: traffic redistributed across sh-42 -> sh-47, sh-9
[1777777840] telemetry: p95=320ms p99=680ms
```

maya_oncall: nice. p99 now 680ms, p95 near normal. I'll keep bridge open for 30m to watch rollback and let SRE run postmortem. Rory, please mark rollout r-20260315-43 paused and schedule a fix for weight calc.

rory_router: Rollout paused. Tagging for rollback root cause: rounding-edge-case + hotkey bias. WIP patch in PR #291.

katy_prod: customer note ready, low severity, no data loss, affected sessions ~0.7% of streaming traffic during window. Sending to incident channel and product ops.

maya_oncall: handing off to angela_sre for post-incident scrub and follow-up. I'm logging this as P1->P2 after mitigation. Oncall handoff: I finish shift in 10m, angela you take the bridge. :white_check_mark:

angela_sre: taking bridge. Will own postmortem and add emergency cap to runbook as temporary step. Also will coordinate with routing team to revert weights and roll patch.

rory_router: noted. I'll link PR and schedule a minor deployment to fix weight calc tomorrow.

maya_oncall: closing live mitigation. Final telemetry snap: p95=310ms p99=650ms, misroute rate down to 1.2%. Closing thread here, will attach logs to ISSUE-4821 and postmortem doc. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
